title: Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen
text: Pride and Prejudice is a romantic novel by Jane Austen, first published on January 28, 1813. The story follows Elizabeth Bennet, the second of five daughters in a middle-class English family, and her relationship with the wealthy Mr. Darcy, whom she initially finds arrogant. The novel explores themes of love, marriage, social class, and self-improvement through wit and irony. The opening line, 'It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife,' is one of the most famous in English literature. Pride and Prejudice is consistently rated among the greatest novels in the English language and has inspired numerous film, television, and stage adaptations.
